feasibility_order: Every normalized floor deficit and every positive raw/smooth hard violation nonincreasing; no reference-observable endpoint lost.
phase_delay_order: Absolute pair phase and excess pair interval delay componentwise nonincreasing on reference-observable support; every within-Jones/path absolute principal interval-delay difference nonincreasing on reference support.
other_objectives: Retained slope/gain/shape/isolation-advice terms individually nonincreasing; no new cross-goal weights.
candidate_operability: Both existing observable warning flags false, existing per-frequency/per-interval support nonempty.
progress_required: At least one strict improvement in protected feasibility, raw sampled phase/delay, or retained advice; scalar decrease alone is not progress.
threshold_transitions: Newly observable support is reported separately, not compared to invented baseline phases; downward crossings are rejected.
proposal_status: proposed until all guards pass and decision persistence succeeds; no optimizer-state mutation in adapter.
accepted_status: accepted_optimization_progress, with explicit feasibility_restoration / sampled_phase_delay_progress / retained_advisory_progress category; infeasibility retained.
numerical_comparisons: Exact finite float64, no hidden tolerance; conservative restriction rather than new physical requirement.
unresolved_decision: Any desired compensation between already-observable metrics, directions, bands or retained advisory terms needs explicit bounds/priorities; no tradeoff is invented. Floor/coverage regression remains prohibited.
persistence: Both evaluated records including invalid provenance are saved before gating; decision saved before returning; either persistence failure raises without an acceptance result.
